title: Cosmetics brand selling online from Texas
assumptions: A cosmetics brand in Austin that makes its own products and sells them online, with a small studio open to customers: answered the intake (makes them, doesn't import). FDA's facility registration and product listing (MoCRA) and the ingredient declaration are stated; Texas's own remote seller and marketplace rules are not, since the seller is in Texas.
